title: Makita DHP490F001 18V LXT Brushless Cordless Hammer Driver Drill | 65 N·m Torque | 13 mm Keyless Chuck | 3 Mode Operation | 1 × 3.0Ah Battery, 1 x Charger & 1 x Carry Bag

description: The Makita DHP490F001 18V LXT Brushless Cordless Hammer Driver Drill is a compact yet powerful solution designed for professionals who need reliability, control, and durability on the jobsite. Powered by an 18V LXT lithium-ion battery and a high-efficiency brushless motor, it delivers an impressive 65 N·m of maximum torque, making it suitable for demanding drilling and fastening tasks. This versatile tool offers three action modes: drilling, hammer drilling, and screwdriving, allowing seamless switching between applications. The mechanical 2-speed gearbox provides low speed for high-torque work and high speed for fast drilling, while the 20 torque settings ensure precise fastening control. With a maximum no-load speed of 1,900 RPM and impact rates up to 28,500 IPM, the DHP490F001 handles a wide range of materials, including wood up to 38 mm, steel up to 13 mm, and masonry up to 13 mm. The 13 mm single-sleeve keyless chuck allows quick and secure bit changes. Designed for comfort and durability, the drill features an ergonomic grip, compact body for tight spaces, built-in LED job light with pre-glow and after-glow, and a convenient hanging hook. Extreme Protection Technology (XPT) enhances resistance to dust and light water exposure, ensuring dependable performance in harsh site conditions. Integrated battery protection safeguards against overloading, overheating, and over-discharging. Included in the Box: Cordless hammer driver drill, Carry bag, 1 x 18V 3.0 Ah battery, and charger. Warranty: 1 year warranty on tool and 6 months warranty on battery and charger.
